text:
Jordan: Heads-up: saw ~$28,450 in untagged GPU charges hitting project 'search-staging' over the last 72h. Root cause looks like expired sandbox credits + autoscaler bug launching jobs with no `team` label. Need an allocation plan before we close the month. cc @Hannah @Eli

billing-bot: Alert: unexpected GPU spend spike for project search-staging. Delta +$28,452 in 72h. Detailed export: https://billing.internal/exports/1876543210-search-staging-spike.csv

Hannah: Oof. Can you paste the top 10 rows from the export? I want to see which pool/instance types.

Jordan: paste (trimmed):
```
2026-02-25T03:12Z, instance-x7, n1-standard-32, us-central1, gpu-v100, 9.5
2026-02-25T03:13Z, instance-x8, n1-standard-32, us-west1, gpu-v100, 8.9
2026-02-25T03:20Z, instance-y2, n1-highmem-16, us-central1, gpu-a10, 6.2
```

Eli: Looks like two big V100 machines plus some A10s. These rows are untagged? Could be the sandbox job controller didn't set labels after credits expired and fallback triggered paid pool.

Nora: For month-end, do we want to: (A) charge full amount to 'Search' product team, (B) split 60/40 between Search and Platform (autoscaling safety), or (C) record as infra loss and absorb? I need approver for any internal invoices.

Hannah: Proposal: split 65% Search / 35% Platform. Rationale: majority is from search experiments, but platform should carry a portion for the autoscaler bug. Also open vendor case for potential retro credits since sandbox should've prevented paid provisioning.

Jordan: I agree. Also will run a backfill to tag rows that match the sandbox job ids so dashboards don't keep screaming. SQL I plan to run (safe mode):
```
UPDATE billing.gpu_usage
SET label='sandbox-fallback', attributed_team='search'
WHERE project='search-staging' AND ts >= '2026-02-24' AND instance_id IN (
  SELECT instance_id FROM debug.sandbox_fallback_instances WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-02-24' AND '2026-02-26'
);
```

Eli: Make sure to include a dry-run first and a tombstone flag so we can revert if anything mismatches. Also dump a CSV of affected instance_ids and meter_ids for the vendor case. I'll prepare the CSV template.

Nora: I'll approve a temporary internal transfer of $10k to cover the immediate hit out of the Platform contingency (GL: PLAT-OPS-2026). Rest will be charged to Search pending vendor response. Approver: Nora (Finance Director). Please attach FIN-REQ tag.

billing-bot: Ticket created: Case 123321 with Cloud Billing Support. Expected response window 4-6 business days. Reference: Case 123321.

Hannah: Jordan, please put the allocation split in the cost ledger like: Search 65% -> GL SEARCH-EXP-2026, Platform 35% -> GL PLAT-OPS-2026. Add a memo: "sandbox credits expired; split provisional pending vendor credit (Case 123321)".

Jordan: Will do. Also logging follow-ups: 1) backfill tag tonight (dry-run), 2) push CSV to case, 3) ledger entry after internal transfer posts.

Eli: After vendor reply we'll either post a refund entry and reverse the internal charge proportionally or keep allocation if credit denied. I'll own reconciliation.

Nora: Thanks. Please escalate to me if vendor pushes back or if credit < $10k since I'll need to approve absorbing remaining cost.

Jordan: Noted. Leaving this thread open until Case 123321 resolves. Will ping weekly updates. :ear:
